candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release

blender.skin: One skin; rigid props plus two-weight smoothstep blends at the shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, the body midline, the haunches, the tail chain and the antenna
blender.root: Identity, fixed floor-centred root; no root animation; the hips translate for the bob, the pounce travel (returns by the end) and the seated defeat
blender.bind_pose: Four paws down with the sheet tail curl, as the sheet notes suggest; IK controls at rest reproduce it (max matrix error 1.4e-06). The sheet tiptoe is idle at 0 s.

export.compression: None; no Draco, Meshopt or KTX2 requirement

preview.source: Exact delivered GLB via Three.js GLTFLoader
preview.renderer: Chromium headless ANGLE SwiftShader, real WebGL raster; no physical device claim
preview.main_stills: idle clip at 0 s (the sheet tiptoe); rest-*.png are the bind pose
preview.lighting: Warm hemisphere plus three directional lights; ACES tone mapping exposure 1.0
